Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.text: Sunita says Ramesh came to see it yesterday.
Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.quote: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.text: Ramesh says the flat is a 2BHK with two rooms, a hall, and a kitchen, and asks whether the bathroom doors also need work.
Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.quote: Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kamre, hall, kitchen. Bathroom ke darwaze bhi karne hain na?

Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.text: Sunita says the job also includes the doors and the balcony railing, with two coats on the walls and one coat on the ceiling.
Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.quote: Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing bhi. Walls pe do coat chahiye, ceiling pe ek chalega.

Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.text: Ramesh says the job includes walls with two coats, the ceiling with one coat, doors, railing, and putty where needed.
Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.quote: Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek coat, darwaze aur railing pe enamel. Putty jahan zaroorat ho wahan kar dunga.

Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.text: Sunita says she will bring the paint herself, from her brother's shop, and asks Ramesh to quote only the labour.
Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.value: paint supplied by hirer; labour only
Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.quote: Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki dukaan hai. Aap sirf labour ka batao.

Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.text: Ramesh says the labour-only job will cost 15,000 rupees.
Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.quote: Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka madam... 15 hazaar lagega.

15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.text: Sunita says 15,000 rupees is too much, since it is only labour.
15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.quote: 15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi to hai.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh says three workers will be needed and the job will take six days.
Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.quote: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh offers to do the labour-only job for 14,000 rupees.

12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..text: Sunita offers to do the labour-only painting job for 12,000 rupees.
12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..quote: 12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon.

12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.text: Ramesh says the price is 13,000 rupees as his last offer, not less.
12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.quote: 12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, last. Isse neeche nahi.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

Advance kitna loge?.text: Sunita asks how much advance Ramesh will take.

3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.text: Ramesh asks Sunita to pay 3,000 rupees in advance for the boys' wages.
3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.quote: 3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena padta hai.

Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.text: Sunita accepts the 3,000 rupees advance Ramesh asked for.
Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.quote: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.text: Sunita says the 3,000 rupees advance will be given tomorrow morning in cash.
Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.quote: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

Ji. Aur baaki?.text: The worker asks what about the बाकी payment.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.text: The worker says 3,000 rupees is the advance.
Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

Ramesh says the hirer should remove the stuff from the rooms tomorrow.
Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron s.quote: Kal kamron se saamaan hata lijiyega.

Aur khatam kab hoga?.text: Sunita asks when the work will finish.

Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.text: The worker says the job will start Wednesday and finish by next Monday.
Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.value: start Wednesday, finish by next Monday
Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.quote: Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho jayega.

Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office.text: Sunita asks whether the work will be finished by Monday, and says she will have office from Tuesday so nobody will be home after that.
Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office.quote: Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office hai, uske baad ghar pe koi nahi hoga.

Pakka madam, Monday shaam tak..text: Ramesh accepts the finish as Monday evening.

Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.text: Sunita asks what happens if they leave the work in the middle and go away.
Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.quote: Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale gaye to? Aajkal bahut hota hai ye.
